sections.title: About Latitude Zero Cottages
sections.content:
Latitude Zero Cottages sits at one of the most remarkable crossroads in East Africa — where the Equator crosses the road to Queen Elizabeth National Park. We opened our doors to give safari travellers and nature enthusiasts a genuine place to rest: clean rooms, fresh food, and a team that knows the park's rhythms.

Whether you are arriving after a long game drive, planning an early morning launch, or simply want to experience Uganda's western corridor, we are here to make it easy.
